reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date, and I haven't recorded it anywhere as confirmed.

- **What I found:** Nothing Pree can see backs up the date. There's no Brackenwater Freight Co. account folder, contract or renewal record in the shared files, and nobody has mentioned their renewal in #central-team. The only mention is the North team cheat sheet. It lists Brackenwater as a Great Lakes LTL account but gives no renewal date.
- **What I suggested:** Brackenwater looks like a North team account, so I told Pree to ask its account owner or June on deal desk to check the date against the contract.
- **Knowledge brain:** gbrain refused my search. Its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. Someone on the brain host needs to bind the token to the members it serves before it can be used.
